# Config reference

<!-- Generated by `medic gen-docs`. Do not edit. -->

medic reads `medic.yaml` (or `medic.yml`) from the working directory, `-c FILE`, or `-c -` for stdin.
Add this first line for editor completion and validation:

```yaml
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rogsiel/medic/main/schema/medic.schema.json
```

## Top-level keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` **(required)** | integer | `0` | Config format version. Must be 1. |
| `secrets` | list of string |  | Names of environment variables whose values are masked (***) in all output (values shorter than 4 characters are not masked). |
| `defaults` | mapping |  | Settings applied to every check that does not set its own. |
| `defaults.timeout` | duration |  | Time limit for one attempt of a check (default 5s). |
| `defaults.retry` | mapping |  | Retry policy for checks without their own (default: no retry). |
| `defaults.retry.until` | duration |  | Keep retrying until this much time has passed since the first attempt. |
| `defaults.retry.attempts` | integer | `0` | Maximum number of attempts in total (1 = no retry). |
| `defaults.retry.interval` | duration |  | Pause between attempts (a small random jitter is added). |
| `concurrency` | integer | `0` | Maximum number of checks running at the same time (default 8). |
| `fail_on` | one of: failure, warning |  | What fails the run: 'failure' (default) or 'warning' (warnings fail too). |
| `checks` **(required)** | list of mapping |  | Checks to run, keyed by id. |

## Common check keys

Every entry under `checks:` is keyed by its id (`[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*`) and accepts:

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` **(required)** | string |  | Check type. |
| `name` | string |  | Display name (defaults to the check id). |
| `depends_on` | list of string |  | Ids of checks that must pass (or warn) before this one starts. If any of them fails or is skipped, this check is skipped. |
| `tags` | list of string |  | Labels for selecting checks with --only/--skip tag:NAME. |
| `timeout` | duration |  | Time limit for a single attempt (default: defaults.timeout). |
| `retry` | mapping |  | Retry a failing check, e.g. {until: 60s, interval: 2s} or {attempts: 3, interval: 1s}. |
| `retry.until` | duration |  | Keep retrying until this much time has passed since the first attempt. |
| `retry.attempts` | integer | `0` | Maximum number of attempts in total (1 = no retry). |
| `retry.interval` | duration |  | Pause between attempts (a small random jitter is added). |
| `allow_failure` | bool | `false` | Report a failure as a warning so it never fails the run; dependents still run. |

## Check types

- [`cpu`](checks/cpu.md): Sample CPU usage on this machine.
- [`disk`](checks/disk.md): Check usage and free space of the filesystem holding a path.
- [`dns`](checks/dns.md): Resolve a hostname, optionally via a specific DNS server, and check the addresses.
- [`exec`](checks/exec.md): Run a command and judge it by exit code and output, or let it report its own result as JSON.
- [`file`](checks/file.md): Check that a file exists (or not), its permissions, age and contents.
- [`http`](checks/http.md): Request a URL and check status, body, JSON fields and latency.
- [`load`](checks/load.md): Check the load average relative to the number of CPUs (not supported on Windows).
- [`memory`](checks/memory.md): Check RAM usage on this machine.
- [`ping`](checks/ping.md): Send ICMP echo requests and check packet loss and round-trip time.
- [`ssh`](checks/ssh.md): Check that an SSH server answers, and optionally that key authentication works.
- [`swap`](checks/swap.md): Check swap usage on this machine (passes when no swap is configured).
- [`tcp`](checks/tcp.md): Connect to a TCP port; optionally require it to be closed or to send a banner.
- [`tls`](checks/tls.md): Verify a TLS certificate chain and how many days it has left.

## Value types

Quantities are strings with a unit; bare numbers are rejected so nothing is ambiguous.

| Type | Format | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| duration | A duration with a unit: ns, us, ms, s, m, h (e.g. 500ms, 5s, 2m, 1h30m). | `500ms`, `5s`, `2m` |
| size | A size with a unit: B, KB, MB, GB, TB (powers of 1000) or KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB (powers of 1024). | `512MiB`, `10GB` |
| percent | A percentage with a % suffix (e.g. 85%, 99.5%). | `85%`, `99.5%` |
| days | A whole number of days with a d suffix (e.g. 30d). | `7d`, `30d` |
| {warn, fail} X | A threshold: `{warn: X, fail: X}`, at least one bound. Each key says whether higher or lower values are worse. | `{warn: 80%, fail: 95%}` |

## Environment variables and secrets

`${VAR}` is replaced in any string value. An unset variable is an error; use `${VAR:-default}` for a fallback
and `$${` for a literal `${`. Variables listed under `secrets:` are masked as `***` in every output.

## Ordering and retries

All checks run in parallel (up to `concurrency`). `depends_on` makes a check wait until its dependencies
pass or warn; if one fails or is skipped, the dependent is skipped. `timeout` bounds one attempt; `retry`
repeats a failing check (`{until: 60s}` or `{attempts: 3}`). `--wait 2m` applies `retry.until` to every
check without its own retry.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Healthy (warnings allowed unless `fail_on: warning`) |
| 1 | A check failed (or warned with `fail_on: warning`) |
| 2 | Config or usage error |
| 3 | Internal error in medic |
